date.description: Quarter-end date index (parquet index column; first QUARTERLY pair); spans 2001-03-31 through 2026-03-31.

eci_total_comp_idx.description: FRED ECIALLCIV: Employment Cost Index — Total compensation, All Civilian. Quarterly, SA, index Dec 2005 = 100. Measures employer labor costs (wages + benefits); the Fed's preferred wage-inflation gauge. Countercyclical prior: faster comp growth = wage-inflation pressure = risk-off.

unrate.description: FRED UNRATE: civilian unemployment rate, quarter-end month value. Control series.

dgs10.description: FRED DGS10: 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield, quarter-end value. Control.

fed_funds.description: FRED DFF: effective federal funds rate, quarter-end value. Control.

vix.description: CBOE VIX index, quarter-end close (Yahoo ^VIX). Control / regime variable.

spy.description: SPY adjusted close, quarter-end (Yahoo, auto-adjusted). Target asset.

eci_total_comp_pct_qoq.description: 1-quarter percent change in eci_total_comp_idx. SA source => seasonally clean. Effective start 2001-Q2.

eci_total_comp_pct_2q.description: 2-quarter (~6M) percent change in eci_total_comp_idx. Effective start 2001-Q3.

eci_total_comp_pct_yoy.description: 4-quarter (year-over-year) percent change in eci_total_comp_idx — the headline wage-inflation read (BLS/Fed convention). Effective start 2002-Q1.

eci_total_comp_ma8q_idx.description: 8-quarter (~2yr) rolling mean of eci_total_comp_idx (min 6 obs). Trend line for deviation-from-trend.

eci_total_comp_dev_trend_pct.description: Percent deviation of eci_total_comp_idx from its 8-quarter moving average.

eci_total_comp_zscore_20q.description: Rolling 20-quarter (~5yr) z-score of the LEVEL (min 12 obs). Quarterly analogue of the monthly pairs' 60M z-score. Effective start ~2003-Q4; consumes ~12 of 101 obs before first value.

eci_total_comp_yoy_zscore_20q.description: Rolling 20-quarter z-score of eci_total_comp_pct_yoy (min 12 obs). Effective start ~2004-Q4 (YoY needs 4q + window needs 12q).

eci_total_comp_accel_pct.description: First difference of eci_total_comp_pct_qoq (percentage points). Wage-growth acceleration — the inflation-momentum signal. Effective start 2001-Q3.

eci_total_comp_yoy_accel_pct.description: First difference of eci_total_comp_pct_yoy (percentage points). Smoother acceleration read. Effective start 2002-Q2.

spy_fwd_1q.description: Forward 1-quarter (~3M) SPY return (decimal). Regression/tournament target — quarterly analogue of the monthly pairs' spy_fwd_3m.
